notes.source: Shot model metrics from SofaScore (not Understat / Opta / FPL expected_goals).
notes.sot: On target = goal + save + post. Own goals excluded.
notes.xa: xA_sf is lineup expectedAssists (match totals), not per-shot assister.
notes.per90_player: Player per-90 uses FPL/Opta Premier League minutes after player_code map.
notes.situations: Native SofaScore situation labels. Penalty shots are only in the penalty slice.
